{{Quote|Bimmisaari and some of her allied worlds in the Halla sector just announced they were defecting to the Confederation.''"<br />"''Not a significant loss.|[[Cha Niathal]] and [[Darth Caedus]]|<ref name="Fury" />}}
The '''Halla sector''' was a sector located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] and [[Danuta]].

==History==
Shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] based on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] was responsible for an area known as [[Sector 3 (Oversector)|Sector 3]], which seems to have included at least parts of both the Halla and [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sectors]], since it extended as far as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="DL:TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>
